name: paketabot
description: The dependency bot that speaks Paket.

scripts.build: dotnet fable src/PaketaBot.App/PaketaBot.App.fsproj --lang typescript --outDir build/ts/app && dotnet fable src/PaketaBot.Runner/PaketaBot.Runner.fsproj --lang typescript --outDir build/ts/runner && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.build:test: dotnet fable test/PaketaBot.Tests/PaketaBot.Tests.fsproj --lang typescript --outDir build/ts/test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.check: dotnet build PaketaBot.slnx && pnpm build && pnpm build:test
scripts.dev: dotnet fable watch src/PaketaBot.App/PaketaBot.App.fsproj --lang typescript --outDir build/ts/app --runWatch pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json
